html:
Charlotte, NC, August 14, 2017 — Meridian Local, of Charlotte, NC, partnered with Gusto, a leading human resources suite for small businesses, for its Member Benefits Program. Gusto is committed to creating a world where work empowers life by taking complicated business tasks and making them simple and personal for small business owners.

Small businesses that work with Gusto have access to a full suite of Human Resources functions that allow the small business owner to run and manage their business more efficiently and without hassle. Gusto’s onboarding platform is easy to use and lends itself nicely to self-onboarding; however, if business owners would like support or a more personal touch, Gusto offers onboarding support via phone, chat and email. Since its launch back in 2011, Gusto has changed the lives of 40,000+ small business owners with their HR, payroll and benefits services.

Meridian Local and Gusto agreed on the new partnership as both companies strive to provide meaningful resources to small business owners looking to solve everyday business issues. “Our goal with Member Benefits is to continue providing our small business owners endless value and resources, so they are able to continue doing what they love,” said Tim Pirrone, President of Meridian Local.

About Meridian Local

Meridian Local is a division of Meridian Media Group, Inc., one of the nation’s largest media companies. Meridian Local is a digital marketing and solutions organization that specializes in creating the total web presence small businesses need to reach their online audience. Currently, Meridian Local serves 11,000+ clients on a month-to-month basis. Visit www.meridianlocal.com for more information.

About Gusto

Gusto works with 40,000+ small business owners across the United States to make it easy and affordable for small business owners to manage their HR, benefits and payroll. Gusto provides transparent pricing, no hidden fees and no contracts. Since 2011, Gusto has continued to add new products that benefit small business owners and continues to build on its resources.
